events.detail: Live developer page (sha256 d44811de…). Mixed-reality row: "Open-periphery color passthrough with autofocus and depth sensing" (Quest: "Color passthrough with depth sensing"). Use-case text: "High-quality, full-color passthrough with autofocus and depth lets your apps blend the digital and physical worlds." Form factor: "At about 100g, VR Glasses stay light by moving compute and battery into a compact puck connected by a thin tether". Also "5K Infinite Display", "Snapdragon XR2 Gen 3", "Available Spring 2027". Primary copy saved, upgrades meta-0-73 from rumor to confirmed.

events.title: Live Meta compare-devices table: passthrough with autofocus; no camera MP given
events.detail: Live compare-devices spec table (sha256 af5f2422…). Passthrough: "Color stereoscopic (26 PPD) passthrough with autofocus and depth sensing" (Quest 3: "Color stereoscopic 4 MP (18 PPD) passthrough with depth sensor"; Quest 3S: "4 MP (18 PPD) passthrough"). Display micro-OLED, 2412x2288 per eye, 37 PPD, 120 Hz, FOV "70° horizontal 66° vertical", "Snapdragon XR2 Gen 3", 12 GB, "Head, hand, and eye tracking", "No camera-based face tracking available to apps", IPD "56–70mm. Manual, per-eye.", Wi-Fi 7, Bluetooth 5.4, "Up to ~3 hours for media playback", "1x USB-C (puck)", "DisplayPort DP-In (puck)", Android 14. No passthrough camera MP is given for VR Glasses, unlike Quest. Identical at /vr/essentials/compare-devices/.

events.detail: FCC grant 2AYOA-4012 'AI GLASSES' (application 2026-08-31, 9 days; BT/DTS only). Models RW7004/RW7005 = Ray-Ban Meta Audio Clubmaster/Burbank (camera-free). STC to 2027-03-08. Grant confirmed; model-to-product strong.

events.title: Connect 2026: Meta VR Glasses US$1,299.99, on sale Spring 2027; no FCC notice on blog
events.detail: Meta Connect 2026 announced Meta VR Glasses (US$1,299.99, 'on sale Spring 2027'), Ray-Ban Meta Gen 3 (available same day), Ray-Ban Meta Audio (ships 2026-10-13) and new Meta Glasses styles. No FCC authorization notice appears on Meta's VR Glasses blog.

events.title: FCC grants A3LSMO200P/J Samsung Smart Glasses; no public exhibit mentions camera, lens or AF
events.detail: FCC grants A3LSMO200P and A3LSMO200J (Samsung 'Smart Glasses'/'Extended Reality Glasses'; application 2026-07-22). Variants SM-O201P to O204P differ only in 'the design of the front frame'. Wi-Fi 6E incl. VLP, charging case, STC to 2027-03-26. No public exhibit mentions a camera, lens or autofocus.

events.title: Xreal FCC ID 2BBNY-X7012 XREAL Keyboard granted; no Aura glasses grant
events.detail: Xreal FCC ID 2BBNY-X7012 'XREAL Keyboard' granted. Exhibit filenames reference 'AURA_QSG_20260523'. No Aura glasses grant reported (single outlet, Mixed).

events.title: Verification: Meta developer page says VR Glasses have passthrough 'with autofocus and depth sensing'
events.detail: Saved copy (sha256 127d2459...) of the Meta developer page states: 'Open-periphery color passthrough with autofocus and depth sensing' and 'High-quality, full-color passthrough with autofocus and depth lets your apps blend the digital and physical worlds'. Primary copy of the AF claim, retrieved 2026-10-08. The dataset's '26 PPD stereoscopic' wording is not on the page.

events.title: ST launches thin-film piezo MEMS process; poLight named as one of first customers
events.detail: ST launches its TFP MEMS process. "One of the first customers for ST's TFP process is PoLight AS"; "Piezoelectric actuators and sensors can now be manufactured in our Agrate 8-inch fab"; volume production "from a 200mm wafer fab in Agrate for its initial customers in mid-2015". Press article quoting ST.

events.title: Q1 2017 report names ST and Tong Hsing (THEIL) as sub-contractors; 400 to 1,000 wafers/month planned
events.detail: poLight Q1 2017 report: "two sub-contractors – STMicroelectronics (ST) and Tong Hsing Electronic Industries, Ltd. (THEIL). ST produces the actuator, and THEIL assembles the complete product"; "capacity increase from 400 wafers/month to 1 000 wafers/month is under planning (i.e. 900 000 to 2 250 000 units per month un-yielded)".

events.title: Q2 2019: 6,515 TLens and 12,650 drivers delivered
events.detail: Q2 2019 report: 6,515 TLens and 12,650 drivers delivered in the quarter. One of the last explicit per-quarter unit disclosures (round-2 dataset).

events.title: Q4 2019: 109k TLens and 91k drivers delivered; 2019 total about 125k TLens
events.detail: 109k TLens and 91k drivers delivered in Q4 2019; 2019 total about 125k TLens. High-water mark of disclosed unit volume (smartwatch launch; round-2 dataset).

events.title: Q2 2020: new assembly-partner line delayed to Q4 2020, move to lower-cost factory
events.detail: Q2 2020 report: new assembly-partner line delayed to Q4 2020; production to move "to a lower-cost factory" (round-2 dataset).

events.title: Annual Report 2021: ST 8-inch fab, two Asian assembly partners, >1M/month assembly capacity targeted end-2022
events.detail: Annual Report 2021: ST "8-inch semiconductor fabrication plant in Italy"; wafers and polymer "shipped to manufacturing partners in the Philippines and Taiwan"; "poLight collaborates with two assembly partners in Asia"; "targeted monthly assembly capacity is planned to exceed 1 million towards the end of 2022".

events.title: Q2 2022: NOK 4.3m invested in final-test equipment (Taiwan and Philippines)
events.detail: Q2 2022 report: NOK 4.3m invested in final-test equipment in Taiwan and the Philippines (round-2 dataset).

events.title: Q3 2022: main assembly in the Philippines, final test in Taiwan
events.detail: Q3 2022 report: main assembly in the Philippines, final test in Taiwan (round-2 dataset).

events.title: Q3 2023: all assembly and testing now in the Philippines
events.detail: Q3 2023 report: "All assembly and testing is now conducted in the Philippines"; ST finished delivering the Q2-2021 wafer PO in mid-October 2023 (round-2 dataset).

events.title: TDK Philippines opens second factory at Laguna Technopark, Binan (PHP 2.5bn, 400+ hires)
events.detail: TDK Philippines Corp. opens a second factory at Laguna Technopark, Binan (PHP 2.5bn; more than 400 hires over 3 years; products not stated). TDK Philippines has assembled camera-module actuators (CMA) in Laguna since 2014 (company profile pages). BusinessWorld article returned 403 to direct fetch; seen via search summary.

events.title: Annual Report 2024: Philippine partner assembles complete TLens; output low; no new MEMS wafers ordered in 2024
events.detail: Annual Report 2024: ST is the MEMS partner (8-inch fab, Italy); wafers and polymer "shipped to manufacturing partners in the Philippines which assemble and test the complete TLens products and ship them to camera module vendors"; "Output from the assembly partner was relatively low"; no new MEMS wafers ordered in 2024; Philippine machinery and equipment on poLight's books NOK 6.338m (NOK 7.176m in 2023).

events.title: poLight TLens assembly line at Q Tech announced
events.detail: Q Tech line timeline in the research file's cadence section: 'announced 2025-04-15'. No source URL is given for this date in the file; it is the start of the roughly 16-month path to qualified output (all equipment installed Oct 2025, first units in qualification Feb-Mar 2026, 'good and qualified' Aug 2026).

events.title: TDK signs framework agreement to transfer camera-module actuator (CMA) business to Q Tech's controlling shareholder
events.detail: TDK signs a framework agreement to transfer its Micro Actuator Solution (camera-module actuator, CMA) business to Q Technology Investment Inc. (Q Tech's controlling shareholder); closing planned by March 2026. TDK's release names no Philippine site. Q Tech's 2025-05-04 article mentions a Philippines plant (round-2 dataset).

events.title: UN Comtrade: Philippine HS 900211 exports to Viet Nam, Korea, HK collapse from US$18-54m/month to under US$1.3m
events.detail: Philippine exports of HS 900211 (camera objective lenses) to Viet Nam, Korea and Hong Kong fell from US$18-54m per partner per month (Jan-Apr 2025) to under US$1.3m from May 2025. Structural break that cannot be TLens (poLight's entire FY2025 revenue was NOK 20.5m); cause unknown. Recorded only as a caution against reading HS 9002 aggregates.

events.title: June 2025 prospectus: production exclusively with one Philippine assembly partner; Q Tech line launch expected in 2025
events.detail: Prospectus for the June 2025 subsequent offering: "production is conducted exclusively with one assembly partner located in the Philippines", plus a Q Tech line "with launch expected in 2025" (round-2 dataset).

events.detail: Latest visible shipment to "Meta Platforms Technologies" (Burlingame) is dated 06/09/2025, out of 148 shipments shown for Oct 2023-Jun 2025. Visible cargo is accessories, packaging and power adapters (e.g. Weifang Goertek "Meta Quest Manta Type", 2024-09-21). Page marks a "Manifest Confidentiality" event. No headsets or optics visible; nothing after June 2025 although data was synced 2026-10-06.

events.detail: Actutek Philippines Corporation registered with the Philippine SEC (reg. no. 2025070211430-84, "Year of Establishment: 2025"; the number's prefix suggests 2025-07-02). Registry aggregator source.

events.title: Q3 2025 deck: Philippine line ~200k/month installed, 400-500k test, ramp plan to 1M/month; Q Tech line equipment installed
events.detail: Slide 'Assembly & final test line in Philippines': "installed capacity around 200k per month"; "Test installed capacity around 400-500k per month"; "Ramp up plan in place for 1 mill per month"; "Local poLight team of 8 in the Philippines/Asia"; photo captioned "Picture from Theil line" (ties the Philippine line to Tong Hsing). Q Tech line: "Capacity comparable to line in Philippines", "All equipment installed". "Produced > 1 mill, - wafer inventory for several millions TLens".

events.title: TDK Taiwan creditor notice: CMA division spun into Actutek, shares to be transferred to Q Tech by end-March 2026
events.detail: The "Camera Module Actuator Solutions" RM Department is spun into Actutek Corporation effective 2026-01-01, then "all of its shares in Actutek" are to be transferred to Q Tech; sale "expected to close by the end of March 2026".

events.title: Philippine Bureau of Customs notice lists Actutek Philippines Corporation as consignee (B/L TPEDJJ59456)
events.detail: Notice to file entry, discharged February 09, 2026, item 39: bill of lading TPEDJJ59456 (a Taipei-origin prefix), consignee ACTUTEK PHILIPPINES CORPORATION. Shows the Batangas plant importing under its new name. Notices list only consignee and B/L, no shipper or goods.

events.title: CEO: Program A units "likely coming from the Philippines"; Q Tech involved but not alone
events.detail: Q4 2025 webcast Q&A, CEO on the Feb-2026 final call-off for the Q Tech-backed OEM (Program A): "some of them are there, but only the qualification units. Those units which is going into the program is likely coming from the Philippines, but part of them will go to a qualification program. After they qualify, they will go into camera modules." Also: Q Tech-line units compared "to what's produced in the Philippines", and "Q Tech is actually involved in ... all these cases, but not alone." Date correction: BRIEF4 attributed the Philippines remark to 2026-08-19; the verbatim phrase is in the 2026-02-25 Q&A and the 2026-08-19 transcript does not contain it. Refers to TLens from the Tong Hsing line, not camera modules from a Q Tech Philippine plant.

events.title: Annual Report 2025: assembly in Philippines and China (Q Tech line under establishment); AR/MR 55% of 2025 deliveries
events.detail: ST is the MEMS partner (8-inch, Italy); "The polymer and wafers with actuators are shipped to manufacturing partners in the Philippines and China which assemble and test the complete TLens products and ship them to camera module vendors"; "Output from the assembly partner has increased thought the year, and a new assembly line setup at Q Tech in China is under establishment"; no new MEMS wafers in 2025. Philippine machinery and equipment NOK 4.243m, China NOK 2.109m (NOK 8k in 2024), i.e. consigned test equipment at Q Tech. 2025 deliveries: AR/MR 55%, industrial 32%, healthcare 19%.

events.title: Written Q&A: Q Tech line under qualification, limited by a single test machine
events.detail: "This is under qualification ... compared to units produced in the Philippines ... Capacity there is limited by only having one test machine ... If you're going to have a kind of very high volume in that line through that U.S. OEM, they need to invest in more final test capacity".

events.title: Tong Hsing Philippines breaks ground on 26,000 m2 plant at Carmelray Industrial Park I, Laguna
events.detail: Tong Hsing Electronics Phils., Inc. breaks ground on a 26,000 m2 plant for "custom hybrid microcircuits and optically isolated solid-state relays". The firm also offers "image products". PEZA: more than PHP 3bn invested since 1994 and about 3,000 direct jobs. No mention of TLens or poLight.

events.detail: SeeYA starts mass production of 0.91-inch 2560x2560 OLEDoS panels for Meta's "Phoenix" (two per headset), per an unnamed industry source (reported 2026-08-28).

events.title: Actutek share transfer to QT Investment Group completes
events.detail: Actutek share transfer to the QT Investment Group completes (Q Tech Aug-2026 circular; round-2/3 dataset). Actutek becomes a connected person of Q Tech.

events.title: Q2 2026 report: assembly partners busy, no new MEMS wafers, NRE USD 178,662 invoiced to Q Tech
events.detail: "Activity levels and workloads at our assembly partners are relatively high, both due to increased demand and efforts to establish a TLens assembly line at Q Tech"; "No new MEMS wafers were ordered, manufactured or delivered during the quarter"; NRE invoiced to Q Tech USD 178,662 in Q2 2026 (USD 313,141 in Q1 for 2025 work).

events.title: Q2 2026 call: lenses from Q Tech line "good and qualified", some process tuning needed
events.detail: CEO: "what has been delivered as good lenses out of Q Tech line are good and qualified. There are some tuning to be done in some of the processes".

events.title: Post-quarter Q&A: two lines of similar capacity (a doubling) plus new final-test machine doubling Tongxing test capacity
events.detail: CEO: "we will have two lines, including the Q Tech, which will have a similar capacity. That's a doubling. Then we also have order a new final test machine, which will double the test capacity at Tongxing ... the final test machine ... is critical ... standard equipment, which is today at Tongxing at 200,000 can easily be changed". On the Q Tech line: "it was not really built for the capacity of that OEM ... The capacity they need for that particular customer, we would expect will be much higher." CFO: "We have also recruited in the Philippines this year"; CEO: not actively hiring more there. Consumer price "$2 +"; samples priced 2x-4x.

windows.title: poLight Capital Markets Day, Pareto Securities, Oslo
windows.detail: Notice: 'poLight ASA (OSE: PLT) is pleased to invite investors, analysts and media to a Capital Market Day on Friday 30 October 2026. The event will be held the day following poLight's Q3 2026 quarterly presentation and will provide deep-dives into different aspects of the company, as well as an external review of key strategic markets for poLight. There will be opportunities for questions and discussions with key resources, availability of demos and possibilities for one-to-one meetings. It will be possible to follow the presentations digitally. More details on the program and how to register attendance will follow, so please find this notice as a placeholder.' Time 09.00-15.00 CET incl. lunch; venue Pareto Securities AS, Dronning Mauds gate 3, Oslo. No agenda published as of 2026-10-08. The 5 June 2024 CMD agenda (https://newsweb.oslobors.no/message/617897) had CEO strategy, Yole market trends, VP North America BD, CTO roadmap, COO operations, and product demos.

blurbs.analysts: DBS is the only source linking a Meta project to poLight's tunable lens (2026-08-26 PDF, p.4, 1H27 mass production); verified verbatim, a maintain-BUY not an initiation, and the first DBS Q Tech note naming Meta. Earlier DBS notes mention poLight but not Meta. IDC gives category-level forecasts only (no Meta VR Glasses units). The only module-vendor claim for Meta glasses is an unattributed Chinese preview naming Sunny and Goertek, with no model specified; Digitimes echo of The Elec is paywalled. DBS says Q Tech is already shipping AR optical engines to Meta and Samsung (2026-08-26). Any autofocus or TLens claim for a specific product comes from leaks, not from analysts.
blurbs.meta: Meta's developer pages (live and Wayback from 2026-09-27) say VR Glasses passthrough has autofocus; consumer and newsroom copy do not. No source names the actuator or supplier; GadgetGuy reports eye-tracked focusing. Meta VR Glasses launch is expected in spring 2027 (dataset); after launch, Reality Labs camera staff profile updates may become searchable. FCC mirrors (fccid.io) show every 2024-2026 grant under Meta's 2AGOZ and Luxottica's 2AYOA matching a launched product, research device or debug tool; no filing yet exists for Meta VR Glasses or its puck. Grant-to-ship for new products runs -1 to 68 days (median ~35), so a VR Glasses grant is expected roughly 2027-01-10 to 2027-04-30, with photos public ~180 days later. Meta's developer page (primary copy) states passthrough with autofocus; FCC exhibits rarely name camera parts, apart from the 2025-06-30 Oakley HSTN note 'Change Digital component & camera'. The strongest Meta VR Glasses ramp signal is a display item: SeeYA OLEDoS in mass production since May 2026, about 1M panels by late August. Meta's visible US manifests stop 2025-06-09. No camera-module or AF-actuator vendor is publicly named. Ray-Ban Meta Gen 3 (2026-09-23) keeps the 12 MP camera with no AF and poLight said nothing. The only Meta links to Q Tech's TLens are the Liepin job ad and DBS, plus a rumour from the same author as the Samsung T-Lens claim.
blurbs.polight: One commercial release (TWedge PO, NOK 1.2m, 2026-09-21) since 2026-08-20, no TLens order or design-win release. Q3 report 2026-10-29 and CMD 2026-10-30 (guest speakers, agenda pending) are the next catalysts. poLight posted a North America (Bay Area) Technical Sales Engineer role on 2026-02-18 for TLens/TWedge customers in camera modules and AR/VR. Q3 report and Capital Markets Day follow on 2026-10-29/30. poLight's own filings and Q&As confirm ST wafers, Tong Hsing (Philippines) assembly/test at ~200k/month, and a Q Tech China line now 'good and qualified'. No customs source shows any TLens shipment; no new MEMS wafers ordered through 2026-06-30. Watch the Q3 report on 2026-10-29. Oslo Bors NewsWeb feed for poLight (93 messages, Jan 2025 to 8 Oct 2026) shows no insider buying and one exercise-and-sell by the CEO, COO and CTO in Aug 2026 (avg NOK 12.1318). The register is retail-heavy, with no new 5% holder and no public short position. Purchase orders for Programs A, B and C, the 2026-07-10 first consumer AR|MR design-in, and a 2026-09-21 TWedge PO run through the period. Q3 results are due 2026-10-29 and a Capital Markets Day on 2026-10-30 (no agenda yet). A 2026-09-10 CEO answer declined to comment on Q Tech's reported H1-2027 top-tier design-in. These signals neither confirm nor refute TLens in Meta's VR Glasses. Program B ran from a mature proof-of-concept PO on 2025-11-24 to mass-production-priced POs on 2026-04-07, 2026-05-20 and 2026-07-10, the last defined as the first consumer AR|MR design-in. No design-win release has followed. Earlier MR design-wins came 0 and 1 days after Varjo's announcements, and the 2026-10-29/30 Q3 report and Capital Markets Day are the next checkpoints.
blurbs.metaip: LinkedIn trail: Lidu Huang's Meta role (Sep 2020-Apr 2025) names a piezoelectric tunable-lens AF module that passed reliability and high NTI yields; a Bay Area module lead cites 'NTI dToF/Tlens' module process. Neither names poLight. Bagheri's AF post and the Avegant 'DRI for TLens' line are not publicly indexed. New Meta Sep-Oct 2026 job posts name AF and AF/OIS actuators, but not tunable lenses.
blurbs.modules: Hon Hai profile shows a TLens fast-focus module driver completed after Dec 2023 (earlier role lists Meta as a customer); TS-Precision posted a poLight TLens camera module on 2025-09-28; Goertek showed an LC eyepiece lens (not camera AF). Tong Hsing Philippines (Calamba) is poLight's assembly/test partner, inferred only from poLight's own wording ('Theil line', 'Tongxing'). Aggregate trade statistics (Comtrade, PSA) are too coarse to detect TLens flows; ST supplies the MEMS wafers. Foxconn's profile links Varjo HMD mass production to TLens driver work, and Luxshare lists a T-LENS Camera in its CIOE AR optics (2026-09-11). Teardowns of the Q4 2026 launches would be the first hardware proof.
blurbs.qtech: Q Tech's Sep 2026 Liepin batch (162 jobs) shows VCM design and an AR/VR manufacturing role mentioning Meta/Pico, but no TLens, piezo or XR-lens wording. Q Tech's TLens line is the second source; its 2026-08-24 deck claims a TLens + AR Mono Engine ramp for overseas key customers in 2H26 / 2027. Line has a single test machine and was not built for the OEM's capacity. Q Tech (1478.HK) is poLight's largest shareholder (32.97% at completion in June 2025, 29.90% at 2026-06-30) with two board seats, and its decks show TLens moving from 'Future Plan' for VR/AR AF cameras (Aug 2025) to 'TLens + AR Mono Engine - Volume Delivery Achieved' (Aug 2026), with overseas key-customer ramp stated for 2H26 / 2027 as a separate bullet. The actuator supply chain (VCM, OIS, Actutek/ex-TDK) sits in the controlling shareholder's private QT Investment Group; HKEX filings name no TLens purchases, capex or XR volume category, and no US customer. Q Technology (Group) holds 63,743,112 poLight shares (29.66% after dilution), bought at NOK 2.69 in 2025, locked up to about 2027-06-04, with no flagging since 2025-05-21. It put Executive Director Fan Fuqiang on poLight's board on 2026-08-13. A shareholder question (2026-09-03) cites a Q Tech statement about a top-tier customer design-in with MP in H1 2027. The CEO would not map it to poLight's own design-in, and the Q Tech statement was not located in a primary Q Tech source. Q Tech's 1H26 deck reports TLens in volume delivery with overseas key customers ramping in 2H26 or 2027. A 2026-09-28 job ad names Meta and Pico as brand clients, and the CEO said Q Tech was involved in the 2025 POs but not alone.
blurbs.otheroem: PICO (ByteDance) hires for tunable eyepiece lenses with supplier NRE (Mar 2026) and for XR RGB cameras with AF/OIS module experience. Pico (ByteDance) Space Pro filed headset and tethered-puck FCC IDs on 2026-09-01, the closest analogue for how Meta's glasses + puck VR Glasses may appear; exhibits public 2027-02-28. Varjo XR-4 is the proven poLight MR-headset precedent. Pico Space Pro is the leading Program B candidate (Q4 2026 release, tethered puck, Q Tech job ad names Pico), but no autofocus evidence exists and its FCC exhibits are confidential to 2027-02-28. Huawei is ruled out because it launched before the design-in.
blurbs.google: A Google camera engineer's public profile lists TLens (autofocus module) integration; employer and dates are not visible, and no link to Meta is shown. Google I/O (2026-05-19) previewed the Samsung-built Android XR glasses and Xreal Aura. Google publishes no camera focus specs.
blurbs.samsung: Samsung SM-O200P/J (Google Android XR glasses) were granted 2026-09-27 with exhibits showing no camera, lens or autofocus detail; photos and manual become public 2027-03-26. The only autofocus claim for any 2026 glasses is the GalaxyClub leak (2026-01-13), and the Samsung T-Lens stories (2026-02-04/06) are inference from the word autofocus. Samsung's intelligent eyewear was unveiled on 2026-07-22, 12 days after Program B's design-in, and cleared the FCC on 2026-10-01 with a November 2026 launch.
blurbs.xreal: Only the XREAL Keyboard (2BBNY-X7012) has been granted, 2026-09-29; no Aura glasses grant has been reported. Aura was priced on 2026-10-07 at US$1,279 / 1,499 with pre-orders in late October. It has a high-resolution camera and two tracking cameras but no autofocus wording.
blurbs.vcm: The Philippine plant tied to Q Tech is Actutek (ex-TDK, Batangas), which makes VCM/OIS actuators, not camera modules. No source shows TLens or XR work there.
blurbs.alibaba: Ant Group's WAIC reference design (2026-07-22) shows Q Tech's TLens with real-time autofocus, and poLight's CEO tied it to Alibaba. Qwen N1/N1 Pro launched 2026-09-22 with a 50 MP sensor and no focus wording. Sales start 2026-10-13, and poLight has been silent despite the firm date.
blurbs.snap: SPECS (US$2,195) was unveiled 2026-06-16 and ships "later this fall" with no firm date. Snap gave no camera specs and no module vendor is public.
blurbs.rokid: Rokid's gen-2 display glasses launch 2026-10-27. Look-to-pay QR scanning shows the close-range autofocus use case, but no AF wording has been published.
blurbs.rayneo: RayNeo V4 (2026-05-27) uses a 17 mm F2.2 OmniVision sensor with no AF wording, and iO and GT have no camera. poLight stayed silent, so RayNeo is ruled out.
blurbs.xiaomi: Xiaomi AI Glasses gen 2 is only rumoured and Xiaomi denied the report. Xiaomi was an earlier TLens customer (2020 watch) and could fit the silence on Program B.
